notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. Isaac Sim 5.0/5.1, Isaac Lab 2.2.0/2.3.2.post1 and an NVIDIA RTX GPU (README.md:162-174) are not available where the gate runs, so the fake backend is this package's pure-Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py) and it was not compared with an upstream RoboLab episode; the sim backend (gymnasium.make of a registered RoboLab environment after the built-in DROID registration) was not run. The fake returns a 4x6x3 RGB placeholder for the wrist camera and a 2x3x3 RGB placeholder for the viewport camera; the deployed cameras are 720x1280 RGB (robolab/robots/droid.py:48-50) and 480x864 RGB (robolab/variations/camera.py:184-186), and the smaller stand-ins are named in the fidelity gaps. The fake does not model the 100+ benchmark tasks, their success/failure predicates, the frozen terminated-env behaviour of RobolabEnv (robolab/core/environments/env.py:76-104) or an episode length; it never returns terminated or truncated. The DROID joint-position action layout is 8 values (robolab/robots/README.md:28) but the clone states no numeric action bound, so the fake action Box has no finite bounds and the package declares no Limit and no operator-required bound; the conformance suite therefore awards CL2 and reports G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE. Expected warnings of this Gymnasium family package: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x4 for action_space, observation_space, reset and close (they come from the ManagerBasedRLEnv base outside the clone), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.values, seed twice). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
